turns.patient_response: I can’t stop thinking about how I look, especially my face, and it’s really starting to take over my day. I keep worrying that something is wrong with how I look, even when people tell me it’s fine, and I just want it to stop bothering me so much.

symptom_reasoning.S067: The patient is preoccupied with perceived defects in their appearance, especially their face, despite reassurance from others that it looks fine, indicating appearance-focused preoccupation.
